x.guidelines: Must be 280 characters or fewer. Not a single character more. Punchy, contrarian, insight-dense.

threads.guidelines: Casual, conversational, hot-take or thought-provoking question. Max 500 characters.

linkedin.guidelines: Narrative arc: 1-2 line irresistible hook ('see more' trigger) -> relatable real-life experience/conflict -> failure or revelation -> distilled insight/playbook -> clear CTA or discussion question. Max 3,000 characters.

carousel.guidelines: Slide 1: High-contrast Hook + visual idea. Slides 2-(N-1): 1 bite-sized concept per slide. Final Slide: Summary + Call to Action.

substack_note.guidelines: Intellectual, reflective, writer/reader-centric micro-essay for Substack feed. Max 1,000 characters.

substack_newsletter.guidelines: Engaging Subject Line / Title, Hook Subtitle, Thesis Statement, The Backstory / Research, The Key Takeaways, Practical Application, Conclusion / Discussion prompt.
